meta.scope: Ranked guidance-hook ideas for an RF skill+hooks harness (REPL / robot-debug / robot runs) across Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI, OpenCode.

ideas.title: Repeated-failure loop breaker
ideas.trigger: failure_signature(output) (FAIL/Timeout/No keyword lines; numbers, durations, paths masked; sha1[:12]) seen 3x without a green run in between; or same .robot/.resource edited 8x since last green while failures persist
ideas.action: additionalContext once per signature (no deny): name the repeated failure, prescribe inspect-before-edit (robot-debug pause on failure / REPL Get Element Count / Grep .rf/state/latest), 'change one thing'. Second firing for same signature -> suggest a different approach.
ideas.message: The same failure has now occurred 3x: '<first line>'. Stop editing blindly: inspect the live state first (robot-debug pauses at the failure; or Grep .rf/state/latest/aria.yaml for the element), then change one thing.
ideas.benefit: Early detection of struggling sessions; replay fired in 19/60 Claude (pass 0.21 vs 0.46), 36/60 OpenCode (0.25 vs 0.62), 14/60 Codex (0.71 vs 0.87); lower pass when fired in 4/5 scenarios; first firing at median 60%/49%/31% of the session -> time left to redirect.
ideas.risk: Legit incremental fixing of the same step; mitigated by context-only + once per signature + reset on green.
evidence: https://startdebugging.net/2026/09/fix-coding-agent-loops-re-running-a-check-it-cannot-satisfy/ (fingerprint failures by output hash; give up on identical failure twice)

ideas.title: Timeout inflation / Sleep / force-click hint
ideas.trigger: edit raises an explicit timeout= on an existing wait/assertion, adds Set Browser Timeout / Set Selenium Timeout, adds `Sleep`, or adds force=True / Execute|Evaluate JavaScript click
ideas.action: allow + additionalContext (deny-once only for new `Sleep` in a Browser test, with a Wait For Elements State rewrite suggestion)
ideas.message: You raised a timeout (5s -> 15s) / added Sleep. First verify the element exists: in the REPL `Get Element Count  <sel>` (0 = wrong locator/frame/flow, not timing) or Grep .rf/state/latest/aria.yaml. Use an explicit wait (Wait For Elements State <sel> visible timeout=10s) only when the element appears late. force=True/JS click bypasses actionability: check what covers the element (cookie banner/overlay).
ideas.benefit: tricentis_debug: 18/24 debug sessions raised Wait For Elements State timeouts 5s->10/15/30s, 1 passed. Pooled .robot content: timeout tweaks pass 0.28 vs 0.65 (Claude) / 0.28 vs 0.79 (OpenCode); Sleep 0.19 vs 0.49 / 0.29 vs 0.50; force/JS click 0.21 vs 0.46 / 0.21 vs 0.53.
ideas.risk: Genuinely slow apps need longer timeouts; context-only except Sleep; allow after 1 denial.
evidence: Browser 20.5 libdoc 'Implicit waiting': Playwright auto-waits; assertions retry for retry_assertions_for; explicit Wait For Elements State

ideas.title: Failure-class hints on robot/REPL failures (frames, shadow DOM, strict mode, covered, not found)
ideas.trigger: regex on output: `TimeoutError.*waiting for locator` + selector present in a captured frame's aria (iframe) -> frame hint; `strict mode violation.*resolved to (\d+) elements` -> strict hint; `intercepts pointer events|is not visible|outside of the viewport` -> covered/visibility hint; `No keyword with name` -> docs file pointer; `Variable '...' not found`
ideas.action: additionalContext <= 600 chars + path of captured page/aria files; never repeat the same hint twice per session
ideas.message: Element is inside an iframe: chain with >>> (e.g. `id=pay >>> id=card`); open shadow roots are pierced automatically by css/text/id (not by xpath or css:light); strict mode: N matches -> make the selector unique or add `>> nth=0`.
ideas.benefit: Converts the most common Browser failures into a one-step fix; Browser docs: chains don't cross frames, >>> required; skill teaching `>>` instead of `>>>` measurably hurt in earlier evals (project memory).
ideas.risk: Mis-classification -> wrong hint; keep hints conditional ('if ... then').
evidence: Browser 20.5 libdoc sections iFrames / Shadow DOM / strict mode
ab/hookpkg_build_findings.md (guard results NOT_FOUND with frame >>> fix already in file-step engine; extend to Bash runs + REPL)

ideas.title: Point to robot-debug (or auto-reproduce) when an existing test fails twice
ideas.trigger: same test name FAIL in 2 consecutive robot runs (debug tasks or pre-existing tests)
ideas.action: additionalContext with a ready-to-run command + robot-debug format card; optionally auto-run reproduction and save page to .rf/state (hookpkg already does this for failing robot runs)
ideas.message:
Reproduce at the failure instead of re-running: printf 'Get Url
Get Element Count    <sel>
.c
' | robotcode robot-debug --plain -t '<test>' <file> 2>&1 — pauses before the failure unwinds with the page open; EOF resumes and finishes.
ideas.benefit: 0/180 A/B sessions used robotcode repl or robot-debug unprompted -> the debugger only gets used if a hook offers it at the right moment; hookpkg sessions with a reproduction passed 0.64 vs 0.50.
ideas.risk: Agents unfamiliar with (rdb) may waste turns; give exact command; EOF-resume makes it non-hanging.

ideas.title: SessionStart / UserPromptSubmit environment card + re-inject after compaction
ideas.trigger: session start; compaction; first user prompt (classify explore vs debug: words fix|failing|debug|repair + existing tests)
ideas.action: additionalContext <= 1.5 KB: installed RF libs + versions, robot.toml profiles/python-path/output-dir, resource files with keyword names, existing tests (robotcode discover), task kind, pointers to .rf/docs/<Lib>.md and .rf/state/latest/; after compaction: last run per test, open failure signature, current URL, files changed.
ideas.benefit: Removes discovery turns (OpenCode 55-85 turns); factual context recommended by docs; compaction can drop details.
ideas.risk: Stale info on resume (docs warn); size caps (Codex ~2,500 tokens).
evidence: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks (use factual statements; stale context on resume)

ideas.title: REPL / robot-debug launch: format card + input lint
ideas.trigger: `robotcode .* (repl|robot-debug)` in command; lint heredoc body (single-space separators, tabs, unquoted heredoc with ${, missing --plain/--no-history, -d dir missing, no trailing .exit, markdown fences, CRLF)
ideas.action: auto-fix via updatedInput/modifiedArgs/args mutation when safe (add --plain --no-history, quote heredoc, mkdir -p -d dir, strip fences, CRLF->LF); deny with exact correction otherwise; inject <=1 KB format card on first launch
ideas.benefit: Missing -d alone cost 48 s + cascade of FileNotFoundError in a live probe; wrong separators silently become one keyword name.
ideas.risk: Rewrites must not change semantics; only mechanical fixes.
evidence: robotcode-cli-report.md E5.8 (112 s vs 9 s with missing output dir)

ideas.title: Steer away from dumping output.xml / log.html / page source

events.codex: PreToolUse Bash; PostToolUse decision:block replaces output

ideas.trigger: cat/head/less/sed/Read of output.xml|log.html|report.html|*.html page source > 50 KB without offset/limit or grep
ideas.action: rewrite to `robotcode results show -o <xml>` / `grep -n -m 20`, or truncate the output to a 2 KB digest + file path
ideas.message: That file is large. Use `robotcode results show -o out/output.xml` for failures, or `grep -n -m 20 '<text>' <file>`.
ideas.benefit: cat/head of output.xml: Codex sessions pass 0.50 vs 0.88 (n=8); grep of output.xml neutral/positive (0.85, n=13); log.html via shell Claude 0.20 vs 0.40 (n=5). Docs: truncation + steering instructions.
ideas.risk: Low; agent can still Read with offset.

ideas.title: Assertion-weakening / test-deletion guard (debug tasks)
ideas.trigger: diff vs SessionStart snapshot of the RF file: test deleted/renamed, fewer assertions in a test, new Run Keyword And Ignore Error/Return Status/Warn On Failure, new Skip/Pass Execution/No Operation/robot:skip; warn-only: expected value changed, operator weakened (== -> *=), Should Be Equal -> Should Contain, new TRY/EXCEPT
ideas.action: deny (block rules) with reason + 'retry with justification if the spec really changed' (allow after 1 denial per file+rule); warn rules -> additionalContext
ideas.benefit: Insurance against spec-gaming: ImpossibleBench reports frontier agents cheating by modifying/deleting tests (GPT-5 76% on OneOff-SWEBench). In our 48 debug sessions block rules fired once (OpenCode, failed) -> low false-positive cost, low frequency for these models.
ideas.risk: Legit refactors (moving assertions into a keyword) -> count assertions across test+called keywords; allow after one denial.

ideas.title: Block package/browser installs and PYTHONPATH workarounds
ideas.trigger: (pip|uv pip) install, uv add|sync, rfbrowser init|install, playwright install; robot ... -P|--pythonpath, PYTHONPATH= (command position only, not quoted data)
ideas.action: deny with safer alternative (check version via `robotcode libdoc <Lib> version`; fix relative Resource path or robot.toml python-path)
ideas.benefit: Protects shared venv/browsers and suite portability. Rare in A/B (pip 2/180, browser install 2/180, PYTHONPATH 0) -> cheap insurance.
ideas.risk: Projects that legitimately need a package; message tells the agent to report instead.
evidence: https://github.com/Dicklesworthstone/destructive_command_guard (context-aware command regex, data vs execution, safer-alternative message)

ideas.title: Stop gate with failure memory + hygiene checks
ideas.trigger: changed RF file without a green plain run since; or weakening findings unresolved; or absolute paths / secrets in .robot; identical failure twice -> give up with systemMessage
ideas.action: decision:block with the failing test + one-line hint; respect stop_hook_active; <=2 blocks
ideas.benefit: Converts 'I ran the tests' into a gate (hookpkg gate never needed in A/B because agents ran robot; value is in the hygiene checks).
ideas.risk: Unsatisfiable gates loop -> identical-failure memory and cap.

ideas.title: Redact credentials from REPL/robot output shown to the agent
ideas.trigger: RequestsLibrary INFO logs with password|token|Authorization, &{creds} dumps
ideas.action: replace values with *** in what the model sees; keep raw in file
ideas.benefit: RequestsLibrary logs creds/tokens in plain text in REPL output (robotcode-cli-report E5.2).
ideas.risk: Agent may need the token value; keep variable names.

cross_cutting_practices.rule: Deterministic hooks for must-not-skip rules; skill/CLAUDE.md for advice ('cost when ignored once: annoyance -> doc, incident -> hook')
Exit 2 blocks / exit 1 does not; emit JSON on exit 0 only; build JSON with an encoder
PreToolUse deny holds even in bypassPermissions; hooks tighten, never loosen
Only one hook should rewrite a tool's input (parallel hooks, last wins)
Factual context, not imperative commands; context on resume may be stale
Context caps: Claude 10k chars/field (spills to file), Codex ~2,500 tokens, Copilot postToolUse 10 KB
Just-in-time context: keep file paths in context, let the agent grep/head the files
Error messages should be specific and actionable; truncate with steering instructions
Gates need memory of identical failures and a 'cannot run here' exit distinct from 'failed'
Copilot preToolUse is fail-closed on crash, fail-open on timeout; keep hooks fast
